name: The Drag Brunch
description: End your week with a fabulous bang. This unique event combines a delicious brunch with a burlesque-flavored cabaret show for an unforgettable Sunday afternoon.
longDescription:
The Drag Brunch is a recurring event in Porto that merges a meal with live entertainment. It features a cabaret-style performance, incorporating elements of burlesque, presented alongside a brunch service. The event is designed to offer a distinctive Sunday afternoon activity, combining culinary enjoyment with a theatrical show.

Attendees can expect an afternoon of entertainment and dining. The atmosphere is generally lively, with the performances providing a focal point for the experience. The event typically runs for a few hours, allowing guests to enjoy both the meal and the show. The specific venue changes for each iteration, which can influence the overall setting, but the core experience remains consistent.

Tickets are required for entry to The Drag Brunch on May 17, 2026. Given the nature of the event, it is advisable to secure tickets in advance. As the venue varies, specific transport details will depend on the announced location for that date. Information regarding accessibility and family-friendliness would also be dependent on the specific venue.
